generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

not_found: That resource could not be found.

auth.token_expired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
auth.token_invalid: Your session is no longer valid. Please sign in again.

auth.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.

authz.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.

required_fields_incomplete: Some required details are missing from this request.
business_not_verified: Your business needs to be verified before you can request transport.
business_no_active_location: Your business needs at least one active location before you can request transport.
job_not_open_for_negotiation: This job is no longer open for negotiation.
no_negotiation_thread: There is no offer thread yet — the operator must make the first offer.
invalid_offer: The operator changed their offer — here's the latest.
nothing_to_accept: There is nothing to accept right now.
not_a_negotiation_party: You are not a party to this negotiation.
platform_admin_required: This needs a Platform Administrator — it is above the Standard band.
admin_reason_required: Staff actions need a reason. Add one and try again.
note_empty: Write something before sending the note.
note_too_long: That note is too long — keep it under 2,000 characters.
invalid_filter: That filter is not valid. Check it and try again.
high_value_already_decided: A decision has already been recorded for this job.
not_a_high_value_job: This job is not in a high-value band, so no review applies.
not_authorised_to_assign: You are not allowed to make this decision.
step_up_required: This needs a fresh authenticator code. Nothing was changed.
intervention_not_allowed: That action isn't possible for this account in its current state.
config_key_not_editable: That setting can't be changed from the console.

mfa_invalid_code: That code isn't right. Check the app and try again.
mfa_locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes and try again.
mfa_already_enrolled: This account already has an authenticator.
mfa_not_required: Only admin accounts use an authenticator.
high_value_not_reversible: Only a rejected high-value decision can be reversed.
invalid_statement_period: Pick a week that has finished (statements run Monday to Sunday).
invalid_settlement: Check the payment details and try again.
settlement_exceeds_due: That is more than this statement still owes. Nothing was recorded.
duplicate_payment_ref: A payment with this reference is already recorded. Nothing was recorded.

stale_job: Someone else changed this job while you had it open. It has been refreshed: check it and try again. Nothing was changed.
invalid_if_match: This screen sent an unreadable job version. Refresh the page and try again.

invalid_closure_reason: Choose why the incident is being closed.
closure_note_required: Add a note of at least 10 characters.
incident_in_open_dispute: This incident is part of an open dispute; it closes when the dispute is resolved.
invalid_finding: Check the finding: an at-fault finding names at least one party of this job.
finding_reason_required: Give a reason of at least 10 characters.
unfounded_not_allowed: A report can be marked unfounded only once it is closed and Fikisha found no fault.
not_rating_party: Only the job's business or operator side can rate it.
rating_not_open: This job can't be rated now.
already_rated: Your side has already rated this job.
invalid_rating: Give a score from 1 to 5; a comment can be up to 1,000 characters.
